about: Coherence rules for grammar-of-graphics mapping rules. The single source for what the gg-spec skill refuses or warns about before compiling, and for what the mapping builder page (mapping-builder.qmd) refuses or warns about before drawing. Edit rules here, never in either consumer. Checked by scripts/check_spec.R.

types.continuous: numbers treated as quantities (a discrete* column counts as continuous unless wrapped in factor())
types.discrete: categories: text, logical, or any column wrapped in factor()
types.identifier: row labels: a name matching *_id, id_*, *_number, or every value unique in a non-numeric column of more than 12 rows (same test as scripts/describe_data.R)

severities.error: refuse: say what is wrong in grammar terms and suggest the nearest coherent spec; do not compile or draw
severities.warning: compile and draw, but report the message alongside the figure

rules.message: Every figure here needs an x position. Map a variable to x.
rules.ggplot2: Error: geom_{geom}() requires the following missing aesthetics: x.

rules.message: geom_{geom}() needs both x and y. Map a variable to y.
rules.ggplot2: Error: geom_{geom}() requires the following missing aesthetics: y.

rules.message: geom_histogram() computes y itself (a count), so y must stay empty. Remove the y mapping or choose another geom.
rules.ggplot2: Error: stat_bin() must only have an x or y aesthetic.

rules.message: geom_histogram() bins a continuous x, but {field} is {type}. For a discrete x, use bar.
rules.ggplot2: Error: stat_bin() requires a continuous x aesthetic.

rules.message: geom_boxplot() needs one discrete and one continuous position. Wrap one of them in factor(), or map a discrete variable.
rules.ggplot2: Draws one box for the whole data, with a warning about missing groups, so the comparison is lost.

rules.message: A continuous variable can't be mapped to shape: shapes have no order. Wrap {field} in factor(), or use colour or size.
rules.ggplot2: Error: A continuous variable cannot be mapped to the shape aesthetic.

rules.message: Facets split the data by a discrete variable, but {field} is {type}. Wrap it in factor() if it has few values, or bin it first.
rules.ggplot2: Draws one panel per distinct value, which for a continuous variable means hundreds of panels.

rules.message: {field} has {levels} levels: too many panels to read. Facet by something with fewer levels, or filter first.
ggplot2's default shape palette has 6 shapes, so {field}'s other {excess} levels would be dropped. Use colour, or set the shapes by hand.
rules.ggplot2: Warning: The shape palette can deal with a maximum of 6 discrete values. Removed rows containing missing values.

rules.message: {field} has {levels} levels: too many colours to tell apart. Filter, lump the small levels, or facet instead.
rules.ggplot2: Draws them, with hues too close to distinguish.

rules.message: Size implies an order and a magnitude, which {field} ({type}) doesn't have.
rules.ggplot2: Warning: Using size for a discrete variable is not advised.

rules.message: Transparency implies an order, which {field} ({type}) doesn't have.
rules.ggplot2: Warning: Using alpha for a discrete variable is not advised.

rules.message: {field} is an identifier (a row label). It labels rows; it isn't a quantity or a grouping to map.
rules.ggplot2: Draws it, usually as one category per row.

rules.message: A smoother fits a curve along a continuous x, but {field} is {type}. The smooth layer will draw nothing useful.
rules.ggplot2: Warning: Computation failed in stat_smooth(), or one point per group.

rules.message: A smoother (including method: lm) models a continuous y, but {field} is {type}.
